decisions: Change only the existing product fact from before to after while retaining the surrounding knowledge-document structure.
Limit product changes to src/value.txt and docs/knowledge/product.md.
Represent the value file as the exact UTF-8 byte sequence after\n.

risks: An omitted newline or extra whitespace in src/value.txt will fail the exact-content test.

Editing a scaffold-managed file will invalidate its manifest digest.
